title: FOOTBALL | Canon Boone & Anthony Evans III Press Conference - 11/21/26
text: And I know it felt good for you guys to get a win today and celebrate with your teammates post game. It's been a long time coming. This year is a frustrating year, but just take me through the the post game with you guys getting a chance to get a little bit of a breather there and enjoy this. >> Uh you know we we can't celebrate for too long. You know obviously you know it was good to get that feeling again, but you know we got a shorter week this week so you know we're really focusing on you know this upcoming game so you know you can't really celebrate too long. >> Anthony on Monday you told us you were going to walk on senior day, but we didn't see you out there today. Has anything changed between then and now in terms of decision making? >> Uh nah nothing has really changed. I was just you know told if we have another year eligibility then we're not able to walk so that was really the the big thing you know. >> Caleb what do you think just getting a first career win means for Billy after the season you have all gone through with the quarterback position and just his journey here getting to Mississippi State just for him to get his first career win tonight? >> Yeah I really just think it's all about confidence. I think he built a lot of confidence today um in himself with how he played. Um obviously a lot to clean up not just from him, but from everybody. I definitely think feel like this is a big confidence boost uh going into next week. >> Hey Canon obviously a short week uh before the Egg Bowl, but what's kind of the feeling and what what have you guys maybe done throughout the season you know leading into that game knowing how big it is? >> I mean it's really just taking it uh when we got a time um just treating uh every week kind of just by itself, but you know kind of having that going mind at the end of the season to come back home with that trophy's a big deal uh for me especially. Um just trying to um iterate that all week and you know hopefully I mean get the job done. >> Really to both of you I mean you're you're in a position where you win and you're in right? You win one you get to play another one and so to be in that position now with a week in front of you you know kind of what's your going into rivalry week? >> Uh really I just say, you know, it's you know, just taking it one week at a time like Bo said, you know, we as a as a state, you know, know how much this game means to us. So, you know, just really if we do our job and just win this game then everything else will take care of itself. >> Yeah, and really just a lot of the same. Just treating treating this game like no other, but also treating it a little different. Um this game means a lot to like I said me and the whole state. Um it's just going out there and getting the win's a big deal. >> Probably. >> Kanan, probably tough for you to focus on the left tackle during the game, but did you see anything from Isaiah uh today over at left tackle getting his first start over there? You might have to go back and watch it on film, but what what were kind of your impressions on what you did know and see? >> Yeah, I feel like I played hard. Um I feel obviously it was a game time decision uh with him having to go in there and start. I I feel like I played well. Um I mean like I said a minute ago, I like to clean up from everybody. Um but I mean I feel like he did what he needed to do and obviously at the end of the day got the job done. >> Both of you guys started with Anthony. What was it like to see the fast and far back in the offense? I think three of the touchdowns took less than a minute, another one barely a minute. Was Was it good to see the old style coming back? >> Oh yeah, it was it was great to see it coming back. You know, we've been talking about it all week, you know, how we going to take shots and you know, just try to get back on track and I think it's just really building confidence and Billy showing it you know, we going to make the plays for him we just give us a chance really to just make the plays. >> Yeah, same thing. I mean just building that confidence this week um for Billy knowing that he can do it bringing in the next week. We're going to need it. >> Kanan, what do you feel like was working for you receiving wise? >> Uh really just I mean just being myself, you know, I really just when like I was taught growing up, you know, at the receiver position if the ball's in the air it's ours. So, really just trying to you know, stay by that mindset. >> With both you guys being seniors, just how how good does it feel to end your your Mississippi State career as winning your last game at Davis Wade Stadium? >> I mean, it's been it was a big deal for me personally. Um I was a little emotional before the before the game, obviously. It's my whole career here. It's end of a chapter for me. Um but, you know, ending it off with a win it's a pretty good feeling. >> Again, we we've always heard about Xavier's uh burst of speed once he breaks the line of scrimmage. What how satisfying was it as an offensive lineman to see him get that that big touchdown run? >> I mean, it's great. As an offensive lineman, when you break big touchdowns like that, I mean, I love it and I know other all the other offensive linemen loved it. Um it was great to see him kind of back in action doing something like that. It was huge. >> Kennedy, there are some times that Billy just does some tough stuff. Like he like he broke two tackles. As an offensive lineman, when you see him, just got to keep moving and keep blocking. It seems like he can find his way out of trouble and and then get himself in trouble and out of trouble. What's it like as a lineman kind of watching him when he just takes off and goes and improvises? >> Yeah, I mean, he's Billy's a tough kid. I think I said it um his first start. I mean, he'll he's going to go out there and die for us on that field. Um and seeing something like that play like that it definitely inspires us to do everything that we can in our power to go block for him for as long as we can. And seeing him do the things he did today was huge for us and like I said, just all it's all about inspiring confidence. I feel like he did that today. >> All right. Thank you, guys. >> Thanks. >> Thank you.
